name: Irmfrid Burkhard
original_name: イルムフリート=ブルクハルト
source:
Irmfrid is a man with an overflowing dauntless personality. As the First Seat of the "Seventh Chord", he is the Knights's commander, as well as the strongest man of the group. Although he has fought through a great number of battles and won due to his overwhelming abilities, Irmfrid tends to prioritize helping his comrades in danger over winning the battle. At a glance, he may seem like a moody person who does not show any motivations for doing his duties. However, he considers anyone who is his friend as a part of his family. Irmfrid tends to dote on his daughter, [url=https://vndb.org/c18803]Alicia[/url], and is very overprotective for her.

Irmfrid excels in close proximity combat where he deals one powerful blow to an enemy's body, bringing them to certain death. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=853983]Getchu[/url]]
